signed_rows.behavior: every page in docs/reference has front matter with description, stale_after and non-empty sources, and no other key than those and verified
signed_rows.fails_when: a page other than README.md lacks one of the three keys, has empty sources, or carries another key

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl review due reports no notice anywhere: no page in docs/reference names a missing source, and no .okf concept is left pointing at a page this change renamed or deleted
signed_rows.fails_when: the notices list from kmctl review due --json is not empty
signed_rows.command:
uvx --from git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.10.0 kmctl review due --json | python3 -c 'import json,sys
n=json.load(sys.stdin)["notices"]
print(json.dumps(n,indent=1))
sys.exit(1 if n else 0)'

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl check passes and prints no warning that names docs/reference
signed_rows.fails_when: kmctl check exits nonzero, or a warning line contains docs/reference/
signed_rows.command: out=$(uvx --from git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.10.0 kmctl check 2>&1); rc=$?; printf "%s\n" "$out"; [ $rc -eq 0 ] && ! printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep "^warning" | grep -q "docs/reference/"

signed_rows.behavior: no backticked file name in docs/reference is shorthand for a tracked file: each one that names a tracked file is written from the repo root
signed_rows.fails_when: an inline-code token with a file extension, outside fenced code and not on the allow-list of other-codebase names (embark.json), does not exist from the repo root while a tracked file ends with /<token>

signed_rows.behavior: each page in docs/reference matches the code it describes, its build-history lines (ticket codes as provenance, at-the-time-of-writing state) listed in spike:docs-reconcile/1 are rewritten as current facts, and changed pages follow the plain-language and slop-scan rules
signed_rows.fails_when: a reviewer finds a claim the code contradicts, a listed build-history line left as is, or a slop pattern the rules name

resigns.reason: plan review round 1: r2 requires no notice bundle-wide, r4 allow-lists embark.json
